theme: 游戏-脑机接口AR游戏设计赛

content.text: This is a screenshot from the first playable version of the game prototype. As you can see, using a simple EEG device, the user can control the scaling of geometric shapes on the screen, with latency kept under 200 milliseconds and stability reaching 85%.

Excellent! I've designed a complete AR scene concept based on this mechanism—a miniature model of a futuristic city floating in a real room, changing with focus. Visually, I want it to be filled with dynamic light and shadow, just like the cyber-cat chip aesthetic we discussed earlier.

The concept map is stunning, but the current focus is on verifying the stability and latency of BCI control. Remember the Cyber Cat case? Adding complex visuals too early might introduce interference, just like that smart home upgrade.

I understand that technical reliability is a priority, but enhancing the richness of visual feedback can increase emotional impact and attract more users. Just like in the internal testing of health monitoring, data visualization makes creative states more intuitive.

Yes, but we must maintain balance. First, refine the core interaction loop to ensure a solid foundation, then gradually add special effects in phases. This is similar to the step-by-step implementation plan we developed for CyberCat, where we first calibrated and then tested the AR system.

Alright, I agree. Then I can start by designing architectural style assets corresponding to different focus thresholds. For example, when focus is low, the buildings could appear in cool tones and remain static, while at high focus, they could shift to warm tones and exhibit dynamic growth.

Great idea! This can maintain technical validation while preparing for future visual enrichment. We can draw on the experience from brain-computer interface calibration tools to set clear threshold parameters.

Yes, just like the lab demo you shared earlier, the conservative calibration approach ensures the boundaries of animal welfare. This time, we also need to consider the comfort of the user experience and avoid overstimulation.

Speaking of the device, this is a reference image of a mixed reality headset. The prototype is currently screen-based, but it could integrate AR glasses in the future to achieve more immersive interactions, just like the core concept of "consciousness construction" we discussed.

AR glasses can significantly enhance the realism of scenes! However, from a technological ethics perspective, we need to ensure data privacy, as discussed in the internal testing of health monitoring, to prevent the misuse of biological data.

Completely agree. Based on historical conversations, we can integrate a health assessment module and privacy protection measures. First, focus on the core interaction: users control the city model zoom through concentration levels, and we record stability and latency data.

Then I'll start designing the assets. The low focus threshold is set at 30%, corresponding to a minimalist architectural style; the high focus threshold is 70%, corresponding to a complex dynamic style. Visually, it will draw inspiration from cyberpunk aesthetics while maintaining clarity.
The parameter settings are reasonable. We can conduct A/B testing, similar to the Cyber Cat and health monitoring cases, to compare the impact of different visual feedback on user focus.
Great! During testing, I will incorporate comfort monitoring, similar to the manual downgrade switch in the Cybercat solution, allowing users to adjust the visual intensity.

Perfect. This reflects the growth of technological ethics. The prototype development priorities have been clarified: first, refine the core interactions, then iterate on the visuals. We can now proceed to the content production phase.

Yes, based on our history of collaboration, from troubleshooting to experimental design, this prototype development has been much smoother. I'm really looking forward to seeing the 'Consciousness Construction' game take shape!
Me too. Your creativity balances aesthetics and technology, just like in the AR system discussion. Keep collaborating and pushing the project forward.
Thank you! I will complete the asset design as soon as possible, and then we can test the core interaction loop. Let's keep communicating efficiently, just like in our previous sessions.
Okay. Remember, stability comes first, aesthetics second. But your visual contributions are crucial, breathing soul into the game.
Understood! Technical reliability is the foundation, and I will ensure that the asset design supports this. Prototype development is on track, and I look forward to the next iteration.
